label: sim-hci-review-copier-2
assignment: Usability Review of a University Website
source: simulated demo student (persona: copier) run through the real platform
content: Evaluating a standard university student portal reveals three primary usability challenges. First, regarding learnability, the navigation menu uses obscure terminology rather than standard industry labels, such as labeling course registration as 'Academic Enrollment Module.' This creates a high cognitive load, causing new students to struggle locating essential functions. A concrete fix involves adopting intuitive, conventional naming conventions to align with user expectations. Second, concerning flexibility, the portal lacks a customized dashboard feature. Students must manually navigate through multiple layers to access their current schedule, wasting time. Implementing a 'quick-access' widget system would allow students to prioritize frequently used links, thereby increasing efficiency. Third, in terms of robustness, the system fails to provide clear, actionable error messages during course selection conflicts. When a student selects a time-clashing course, the portal simply resets the page without explanation, leading to frustration and repeated errors. A robust solution would involve explicit, informative error notifications that pinpoint the exact conflict and suggest resolutions. Conversely, the portal excels in consistency, a key robustness principle. The uniform use of color schemes and typography across all sub-pages ensures that users can confidently predict the site's behavior as they transition between administrative and academic sections. This predictability significantly reduces user error and fosters a more professional digital environment.

viva.summary: The student demonstrates a good grasp of identifying usability issues in their written report but struggles to articulate the theoretical reasoning behind these concepts during the viva. They have difficulty connecting design principles like flexibility and robustness to specific UI changes.

rubric.revise_next: Focus on reviewing the definitions of usability heuristics like flexibility and robustness to better explain the 'why' behind your design choices.
